intro: Internships and trainee roles shared by companies that want to reach GTU students — for hands-on learning, portfolio building, and exploration alongside your degree.
listingNote: Listings are posted for student awareness. GTUPEDIA does not run hiring or guarantee placement. Always verify details and apply through the company’s official channel.

internships.eligibility: 2nd year and above; portfolio or coursework projects preferred
internships.summary: Work with Studity’s team on learner-facing web pages, small features, and content tooling. Good fit if you enjoy building interfaces and want mentor feedback on real tasks.

internships.eligibility: Strong grasp of at least one programming or engineering topic
internships.summary: Help structure study notes, tutorials, and explainers for GTU-relevant subjects. Ideal for students who teach classmates well and write clearly.

internships.eligibility: EC, EE, IC, or Computer branches; 3rd semester and above
internships.summary: Support kit demos, prototype builds, and customer project documentation at a hardware-focused workspace. Exposure to sensors, microcontrollers, and product testing.

internships.eligibility: Any GTU programme; attention to detail required
internships.summary: Assist with organising product and process documentation for digital projects. Useful if you want editorial or ops experience outside pure coding.

internships.eligibility: Marketing or business students; creative portfolio a plus
internships.summary: Help plan posts, short campaigns, and brand storytelling for a lifestyle brand. Learn e-commerce basics and content calendars in a small-team setting.
